title: Two sessions that claim the same item while the ledger lock is held both succeed, and the later one overwrites the item file
goal: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G1 (BG-m7rrbdnm): cmd_claim re-reads the ledger ids' item files under the ledger lock, but its busy test skips the item being claimed (i != iid) and it saves `it`, the item dict read before the lock, so a claim of the same item another session made while this one waited is not refused: both claims exit 0, the item file holds the stale copy with the later claimer and the claims are doubled. A claim of an item another session claimed while this one waited for the ledger lock is refused as busy (exit 1), and that session's item file and ledger record are kept.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
it={"id":"ST-aaaaaaaa","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"todo","priority":"P3","goal":"g","touches":["x.txt"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]}
(r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(it,indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
led=P.Path(g("rev-parse","--absolute-git-dir"))/"kb-backlog-claims.json";lock=led.with_name(led.name+".lock")
base={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("CLAUDE") and k!="KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG"}
lock.write_text("")
ps=[s.Popen([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by",b],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=dict(base,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=sid)) for b,sid in (("w1","S1"),("w2","S2"))]
time.sleep(3);lock.unlink()
rcs=[(p.communicate(timeout=60),p.returncode)[1] for p in ps]
d=json.loads(led.read_text()) if led.exists() else {}
cb=json.loads((r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").read_text()).get("claimed_by")
ok=sorted(rcs).count(0)==1 and d.get("ST-aaaaaaaa",{}).get("by")==cb
print("two claims of one item while the ledger lock was held: exits",rcs,"| item claimed_by",cb,"| ledger",d);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
